description: This signal detects when an organization has no established process or automated capability to identify and address unauthorized assets on their network. Unauthorized assets represent significant security risks as they may be compromised devices, shadow IT, or malicious systems introduced by threat actors. Organizations must have mechanisms to detect these assets and documented procedures to remove them or bring them into compliance.
applicability: Enterprise IT environments Cloud infrastructure On-premises data centers Remote/hybrid work environments Guest and visitor networks BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) environments

metadata.detection_notes: ### Detection Guidance This signal can be detected through: 1. **No Network Access Control (NAC)**: Absence of NAC solution or 802.1X authentication 2. **Missing Detection Tools**: No passive network monitoring or asset discovery tools deployed 3. **Lack of Alerting**: No automated alerts when unknown devices connect to the network 4. **Undocumented Process**: No written procedure for handling unauthorized assets 5. **No Remediation Tracking**: Unauthorized assets identified but not tracked to resolution 6. **Delayed Response**: Unauthorized assets remain connected for extended periods without action ### Implementation Approaches Organizations can address unauthorized assets through: **Network Access Control (NAC)**: Automated quarantine or restricted access for unauthorized devices **DHCP
